candidates.name: Terracotta Linen-Look Hooded Pullover
candidates.decisionReason: The terracotta linen-look color is useful, but the hooded pullover has a long tunic body, rolled bunched sleeves, black cords and a loose drawstring-lounge presentation that is not the clean Zara-led Resort silhouette required.

candidates.name: Light-Green Textured Long-Sleeve Henley
candidates.decisionReason: The light-green Henley supplies cheerful color, but its deep open neck, rolled sleeves and very long rounded hem create a dated tourist-resort tunic rather than a modern controlled top.

candidates.name: Anchor-Red Relaxed Heavyweight Tee
candidates.decisionReason: The anchor-red tee is heavily dropped, broad and long with streetwear bag styling; it would recreate the oversized-top problem and overwhelm a clean Resort bottom.

candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Resort Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The peacock-blue shirt is a hanger-only open overshirt layered over a separate white tee, so shoulder, body, hem and worn drape are not credibly proven.

candidates.name: Warm-Brown Button-Front Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The warm-brown shirt is another hanger-only twin-pocket overshirt with a long rounded hem and white-tee dependency; it adds a muddy neutral without reliable body proof.

candidates.name: Washed Light-Green Long-Sleeve Polo
candidates.decisionReason: The washed green polo has extreme dropped shoulders, a wide long body and heavily bagged sleeves, making it too oversized and shapeless for the requested modern proportion.

candidates.name: Warm-Brown Controlled Relaxed Tee
candidates.decisionReason: The brown tee is long and oversized with dropped shoulders plus a visible micro wordmark; its dull color and volume do not deliver the bright refined Resort direction.

candidates.name: Creamy-White Corduroy Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The creamy corduroy overshirt is extremely boxy and long with oversized utility pockets and sleeves; it would dominate the outfit instead of acting as one controlled Fall layer.

candidates.name: Ivory Straight-Leg Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The ivory jean has a promising clean color but is shown only as a product cutout; there is no credible proof of rise, seat, full worn width or shoe break, so it cannot receive a visual hold.

candidates.name: Khaki Clean Straight Travel Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The khaki travel trouser exposes a fully elastic waist and long black webbing belt with a soft technical fabric; it reads functional travelwear rather than polished Fall Resort.

candidates.name: French-Blue Clean Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The source is explicitly a slim-fit jean and the worn image shows a narrow thigh-to-ankle line; it conflicts with the no-skinny rule and cannot anchor the corrected Fall Resort silhouette.

candidates.name: Medium-Blue Straight-Leg Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The medium-blue jean is broad through the leg and visibly pools at the shoe, while its slanted trouser pockets and glossy saturated wash look dated rather than relaxed and modern.

candidates.name: Military-Green Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The military-green trouser is shown unworn and wrinkled with novelty bead hardware, so neither clean drape nor a refined Resort finish is proven.

candidates.name: Dusty-Blue Straight-Fit Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The dusty-blue jean is narrower through the thigh and lower leg with a visibly bunched hem; its dated slim-straight line is weaker than the controlled French-blue option.

candidates.name: Off-White and Powder-Blue Windbreaker
candidates.decisionReason: The windbreaker stacks an oversized off-white shell over a large blue hood, dark graphic sweatshirt and cap, creating excessive upper-body bulk and a sporty streetwear mood rather than Resort ease.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Relaxed Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The light-khaki blazer has a long oversized body, low shoulders, large patch pockets and extremely wide black trousers in its proof image; it reproduces the loose-on-loose silhouette the rebuild excludes.

candidates.name: Sapphire-Blue Denim Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The sapphire denim jacket is a dark product-only image with strong white contrast stitching and four-pocket visual weight; fit is unproven and the color would drag the Resort palette dark.

candidates.name: Army-Green Corduroy Snap Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The army-green corduroy jacket is an unworn composited product image with dropped shoulders, bulky utility pockets and prominent silver hardware, leaving both fit and refinement unproven.

candidates.name: Warm-Brown Snap Shirt Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The warm-brown shirt jacket is shown only as a floating product with long rounded tails and large flap construction; it lacks body proof and would make the palette heavy and muddy.

candidates.name: Fresh-Green Button-Up Cardigan
candidates.decisionReason: The green cardigan has a narrow shaped torso, long fitted sleeves and loud red, cream and black retro stripes; it is costume-like and conflicts with the modern relaxed brief.
